english.title: Use on road a wheeled agricultural trailed appliance when maximum gross plated weight was equalled / exceeded
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a wheeled agricultural trailed appliance, namely **(..SPECIFY TYPE..), required by regulation 68 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 to be fitted with a plate, when the maximum gross weight shown in the plate, namely **(..SPECIFY THE MAXIMUM GROSS WEIGHT..), was

(A)_[equalled]_
(B)_[exceeded]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 80(1)(c) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41B of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
